description: This file defines the PredefinedShelfRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide database access methods for PredefinedShelf entities. It includes method signatures for retrieving shelves associated with users, counting shelves, and custom queries involving shelf names.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing PredefinedShelf entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all predefined shelves associated with a specific user, including their books.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a predefined shelf by its name and the user it belongs to.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Counts the number of shelves associated with a given user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined shelf by its ID, including its books.

methods.name: findReadShelf2
methods.description: Custom query to find shelves corresponding to the 'READ' predefined shelf name.
